source_quote:
Do not patch directly; enable the prefix-cache by checking if pcp_size > 1 or dcp_size > 1, and then proceed with the patch.
When enabling VLLM_ASCEND_APPLY_DSV4_PATCH, the following branch logic should be followed. This part will affect the V4 code and needs to be modified.
Please mention this patch file in `vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py` about why we need this patch and how to remove it (refer to other examples).

rule.description: 平台 patch 不应直接应用，而应根据运行时配置条件（如 pcp_size/dcp_size）决定是否启用。每个 patch 文件必须在 `vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py` 中记录其目的和移除条件。

antipattern.code:
# （根据评审意见推断）直接 patch，未检查 pcp_size/dcp_size 条件
# weiguihua2 评论: "Do not patch directly; enable the prefix-cache by
# checking if pcp_size > 1 or dcp_size > 1, and then proceed with the patch."

import vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_ascend_config  # noqa
import vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_distributed  # noqa
import vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_kv_cache_coordinator  # noqa
import vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_mamba_manager  # noqa
import vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_worker  # noqa

# 直接应用 patch，无条件检查
# 前缀缓存 patch 在所有场景下都会被应用
from vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_kv_cache_coordinator import *  # noqa
from vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_mamba_manager import *  # noqa

pattern.code:
# 通过检查 pcp_size > 1 或 dcp_size > 1 来条件性启用前缀缓存
# weiguihua2 要求: 仅在 PCP/DCP 启用时才应用 patch

import vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_ascend_config  # noqa
import vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_distributed  # noqa
import vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_kv_cache_coordinator  # noqa
import vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_mamba_manager  # noqa
import vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_worker  # noqa

# 条件性启用前缀缓存
# 仅在 PCP/DCP 启用时应用 patch
from vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_kv_cache_coordinator import *  # noqa
if pcp_size > 1 or dcp_size > 1:
    from vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_mamba_manager import *  # noqa
